title: sanvitaliopsis nelsonii
intro: Sanvitaliopsis nelsonii, commonly known as Nelson's Sanvitalia, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used to aid in digestion, and its health benefits include relieving symptoms of indigestion, bloating, and stomach discomfort. The therapeutic actions of Sanvitaliopsis nelsonii include its carminative and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to ease digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant are yet to be fully identified, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
